## 1. Goal

Draw the E5 figure: maximum wait against the share of big-memory jobs, aging vs reserve, with error bars. It shows when reservation pays off and is shown in the viva.

## 2. Background

**From BLUEPRINT §6 E5:**

| # | Question | What we vary | Graph |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| E5 | When does reservation pay off? | Share of big-memory jobs (0% to 40%) | Maximum wait with and without reservation |

**From PRD §5 Summary CSV formats (e5 row):**

| File | Rows (key) | `setting` / `x_value` | `policy` values | Metric columns (each with `_mean`, `_ci_low`, `_ci_high`) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `e5_summary.csv` | (E5, big-memory share, policy) | `setting` = `big_mem_pct=<v>`; `x_value` = share of big-memory jobs in percent, 0–40 | `aging`, `reserve` | `max_wait`, `avg_wait` |

Every figure (CLAUDE.md "Working with Ahaana"): one function per figure; a title; labelled axes with units; a legend; error bars or shaded 95% bands from the `_ci_low` / `_ci_high` columns where the summary has them; saved as PNG and PDF with `save_figure` from A-02; reads only summary CSV files; computes no statistics.

## 5. Specification

Columns: `x_value` (percent of big-memory jobs), `policy` (aging, reserve), `max_wait_mean`, `max_wait_ci_low`, `max_wait_ci_high`. x-axis "Big-memory jobs (%)"; y-axis "Maximum wait (ticks)".

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] Title, axis labels with units, legend, 95% error bars; PNG and PDF saved
- [ ] Works on sample and real summaries
- [ ] Ahaana can explain it

## 9. How to verify

```sh
python tools/plot_figures.py --input data/sample_summaries
```

## 10. Viva notes

**How to read it:** as the share of big-memory jobs grows, the aging line climbs (big jobs starve) while the reserve line stays lower.
**Examiner question:** "What does the gap between the lines mean?" — How much worst-case waiting the reservation saves.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Swapping colours relative to other figures (use POLICY_LOOK)
